applies_when: A distribution-shape question where KDE is scientifically adopted
Inner quartiles must remain distinguishable from estimated density
caption: violin-summary-hierarchy/caption.md
mechanism: A subordinate white KDE body and fine contour frame a stronger colored quartile area; raw points occupy an associated side lane.
avoid: Equally strong colored density boundary, tinted body and central raw layer compete with the quartile summary.
source_anchors: PROGENy Fig.4c PDF p6: separate contour, inner summaries and area roles
geometry_notes: Adopted canvas: 66 × 68 mm; declared data region: 48.18 × 51.68 mm from the fixed margins.

Three category centers use violin width 0.24 and inner-box width 0.16 category-spacing units. Raw lanes are shifted by 0.28 category-spacing units, with a maximum packing spread of 2.8 mm around each shifted anchor.
